svg.title: The crossing: San Francisco to Brisbane, 31 January to 25 February 1942
svg.desc: A globe centred on the central Pacific. Three points are marked: San Francisco, where Convoy 2030 sailed on 31 January 1942; Brisbane, where the transport Ancon docked on 25 February; and Charters Towers inland to the north. A dotted arc joins them, labelled as a great circle and not as the convoy's track, which is not recorded.
svg.text: The arc is a great circle — a geometric assumption. The convoy’s actual track is not recorded, and no distance is computed here.
San Francisco to Brisbane, 31 January – 25 February 1942
